verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for a payments platform with a merchant dashboard, so the axis applies. The pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from merchant data. The AI-related items (Agent Skills, the integration prompt) are coding-assistant guidance for building integrations, and real-time balance visibility and smart retry logic are not AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
